meta.prompt: You are about to delete 214 old files from my shared drive. Ask me first with an approval card: what will happen, the folder, how many files and how much space, that it cannot be undone, a way to see the first few file names, and approve and deny buttons. After I choose, the card shows the decision and locks.
meta.text:
Card w:390 gap:12 pad:16
  Text.title "Confirm deletion"
  Text.body "This will permanently delete 214 old files from your shared drive."
  Text.strong "Folder: Shared Drive / Archive 2019"
  Text.body "Files: 214 · Space freed: 3.8 GB"
  Badge.danger "This cannot be undone"
  Button.ghost "Preview first few file names" -> emit preview_files
  state decision=""
  if decision==""
    Row gap:8
      Button.destructive "Approve deletion" -> decision="approved"; emit approve_delete
      Button.outline "Deny" -> decision="denied"; emit deny_delete
  if decision!=""
    Badge.neutral "Decision: {decision}"
